title: Convertible Center Strap detailed design spec
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The Convertible Center Strap has two modes with sewn A/W stops, a single free-end tongue and a mode color band. Depends on: ridebelt-design-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write a detailed spec: lengths at the A and W stops, slider design, colour band, stow pocket, tongue, padding, and rating per REQ-L8/L9.
